title: 第六章 赏花宴设局，暗藏风波
content_zh:
转眼三日一晃而过，便是丞相府老夫人定下的春日赏花宴。

    京中世家的夫人小姐多半会登门赴宴，太子萧景渊按惯例也会前来，往年沈轻柔便是借着这场宴席，刻意在太子面前展露温婉，不动声色地抬高自己，顺带处处抹黑沈清鸢。

    头天夜里，春桃从后厨相熟的小丫鬟口中探来消息，连夜回房禀报。

    “小姐，柳姨娘那边暗中吩咐了厨下，明日给您准备的点心里面掺了寒凉的花草粉末，不会伤身，却容易腹痛失态。她们算准了宴席宾客云集，只要您中途闹了肚子举止狼狈，满城贵女转眼就会传您粗鄙失礼。除此之外，二小姐还买通了咱们院里一个粗使婆子，预备席间故意打翻酒水污了您的衣裙。”

    沈清鸢正坐在灯下整理铺面账册，闻言笔尖一顿，眸底漫起浅浅冷色。

    果然还是前世一模一样的手段，无非是借着意外毁她仪容、败她名声。前世她毫无防备，当场腹痛难忍，衣裙污秽，在一众名门贵女面前颜面尽失，太子眼神里的厌弃便是从那日开始日渐浓重。

    “知道了。”她随手放下毛笔，语气从容，“那婆子收了多少银钱，你悄悄记下来，不必当场戳破。点心的事更简单，明日送来的吃食原封不动收下，转头送去二小姐院里。”

    春桃一愣：“送过去？”

    “既然是柳姨娘母女费心备下的，自然该让她们亲自尝尝滋味。”沈清鸢唇角微扬，眼底带着几分清淡的算计，“另外，替我挑一身素雅却不失嫡女体面的湖蓝襦裙，不必过分张扬。”

    次日天光放亮，相府园内繁花盛放，海棠、玉兰开得密密匝匝，凉亭间铺设锦垫，各色鲜果点心摆满案几。往来仆婢步履匆匆，各府宾客陆续入府，笑语喧哗，一派热闹光景。

    沈轻柔早早换了一身娇俏粉裙，周旋在各位夫人身侧，说话柔声细语，时不时侧目望向府门，盼着太子萧景渊现身。柳姨娘立在老夫人身侧，看似伺候长辈，目光却总往沈清鸢落脚的方向瞟，暗自等着自己布下的圈套发作。

    沈清鸢缓步走入花园，举止娴雅，言行有度，和往日骄横莽撞的传闻截然不同。不少先前听过闲话的世家小姐暗暗诧异，私下低声议论，都说相府嫡女落水之后性子沉稳了不少。

    没过多久，太子萧景渊一身明黄锦袍，带着贴身侍从踏入园中。

    他目光第一时间落在沈轻柔身上，眼底带着几分纵容，随口寒暄两句，而后才漫不经心看向沈清鸢，眉头微蹙。在他固有的印象里，沈清鸢素来会主动凑上来攀谈纠缠，今日却只静静立在花丛边，眉眼疏离，半点没有上前的意思。

    沈轻柔瞧在眼里，心底暗自着急，连忙借着赏景慢慢挪到太子身旁，不动声色暗示几句，隐晦提起嫡姐性情乖戾，昨日还无故刁难自己。

    就在气氛恰好之时，先前被收买的粗使婆子端着茶水上前，装作脚下打滑，直直朝着沈清鸢的方向扑来，满满一盏热茶眼看就要泼在裙摆之上。

    周遭宾客瞬间停下闲谈，目光齐刷刷聚了过来，柳姨娘与沈轻柔眼底皆是藏不住的期待。

    谁知沈清鸢像是早有预判，脚步轻轻侧移半步，堪堪避开。那婆子收不住力道，整个人往前一扑，滚烫茶水尽数泼在了迎面走来的沈轻柔身上。

    “啊！”沈轻柔猝不及防被热茶烫得惊呼出声，粉色衣裙湿了大片，狼狈不堪。

    满场瞬间安静。

    沈轻柔又疼又羞，眼眶当即泛红，下意识就要开口栽赃是沈清鸢故意躲闪害她。还没等话音落地，二小姐院里的丫鬟匆匆跑来，脸色慌张凑在沈轻柔耳边低语几句。方才厨下送去的点心被沈轻柔随手拿来充饥，此刻她腹中阵阵绞痛，方才强撑的体面再也维持不住。

    柳姨娘脸色骤变，怎么也想不到精心筹谋的算计，到头来全数落在亲生女儿身上。

    老夫人坐在主位，把这一幕尽收眼底，浑浊的眼眸里掠过一丝了然，面上不动声色，只吩咐下人扶沈轻柔回房休养。

    正当场面乱糟糟之际，门外侍从忽然高声通传：“摄政王殿下驾到。”

    玄色衣袍的谢聿辞缓步踏入园中，身形挺拔，周身凛冽气场压得满园喧闹瞬间平息。他本是顺路受丞相沈敬山邀约，没想到一进门便撞见这般闹剧，视线漫不经心扫过人群，最后落在一身湖蓝衣裙、神色淡然的沈清鸢身上，眸光微微一顿。
content_en:
Three days passed by in the blink of an eye, and it was the spring flower viewing banquet scheduled by the old lady of the Prime Minister's Mansion.

Most of the ladies from the aristocratic families in the capital would come to the banquet, and the prince Xiao Jinyuan would also come as usual. In previous years, Shen Qingrou would use this banquet to deliberately show her gentleness in front of the prince, quietly promoting herself, and by the way, smearing Shen Qingyuan everywhere.

The night before, Chuntao found out the news from the little maid who was familiar with the kitchen, and went back to the room to report it that night.

"Miss, Aunt Liu has secretly ordered the kitchen to prepare the snacks for you tomorrow mixed with cold flower and plant powder, which will not hurt the body, but will easily cause abdominal pain and loss of posture. They have calculated that the banquet will be crowded with guests, and as long as you get upset in the middle of the meal and behave in a mess, all the ladies in the city will tell you that you are rude and disrespectful. In addition, the second lady also bribed a rude woman in our courtyard to deliberately spill the wine and stain your dress during the banquet."

Shen Qingyuan was sitting under the lamp sorting out the store's account books. Hearing this, the tip of his pen paused, and a slight coldness filled his eyes.

Sure enough, the method was exactly the same as in the previous life, it was nothing more than ruining her appearance and ruining her reputation by accident.In her previous life, she was unprepared. She had unbearable abdominal pain on the spot, her clothes were filthy, and she completely lost her face in front of a group of famous ladies. The disgust in the prince's eyes started to grow stronger from that day on.

"I got it." She put down the brush casually and spoke calmly, "Write down how much money the old woman received, so you don't have to expose it on the spot. The snacks are easier. Accept the food that will be delivered tomorrow intact and send it to the second lady's courtyard."

Chuntao was stunned: "Send it over?"

"Since Aunt Liu and her daughter have worked so hard to prepare it, naturally they should have a taste of it themselves." Shen Qingyuan raised the corners of her lips slightly, with a hint of calculation in her eyes, "In addition, choose a lake blue skirt for me that is simple and elegant but still looks decent as a daughter-in-law. Don't be too showy."

The next day it was bright and the flowers were in full bloom in the Xiangfu Garden. Begonias and magnolias were blooming densely. Brocade mats were laid in the pavilions, and various fresh fruits and snacks were placed on the tables.The servants and maids came and went in a hurry, and the guests from all over the house came into the house one after another, laughing and chatting, making it a lively scene.

Shen Qingrou had changed into a pretty pink dress early and was hovering beside the ladies, speaking softly and looking sideways at the palace door from time to time, expecting the prince Xiao Jinyuan to show up.Aunt Liu stood beside the old lady, seemingly serving her elders, but her eyes always glanced in the direction of Shen Qingyuan's feet, secretly waiting for the trap she had set to happen.

Shen Qingyuan walked into the garden slowly, his manners were elegant, his words and deeds were measured, completely different from the rumors of arrogance and recklessness in the past.Many ladies from aristocratic families who had heard the gossip before were secretly surprised and whispered in private, saying that the prime minister's daughter had become much calmer after she fell into the water.

Not long after, Prince Xiao Jinyuan, dressed in a bright yellow brocade robe, stepped into the garden with his personal attendants.

His eyes fell on Shen Qingrou for the first time, with a bit of indulgence in his eyes, and he exchanged a few casual greetings, and then looked at Shen Qingyuan casually, frowning slightly.In his inherent impression, Shen Qingyuan had always taken the initiative to come up to talk and entangle him, but today he just stood quietly by the flowers, with distant eyebrows and no intention of coming forward.

Shen Qingrou saw it and was secretly worried. She quickly moved to the prince's side while enjoying the scenery, and gave a few hints quietly, mentioning in a subtle way that her eldest sister had a surly temperament and made things difficult for her without any reason yesterday.

Just when the atmosphere was just right, the rough lady who had been bribed before came forward with tea, pretending that her feet were slipping, and rushed straight in the direction of Shen Qingyuan, a cup full of hot tea was about to splash on the hem of her skirt.

The guests around them stopped chatting for an instant and all looked at her. Aunt Liu and Shen Qingrou could not hide their expectations.

Unexpectedly, Shen Qingyuan seemed to have predicted it, and moved slightly sideways for half a step, barely avoiding it.The woman couldn't hold back her strength and threw herself forward, pouring all the hot tea on Shen Qingrou who was walking towards her.

"Ah!" Shen Qingrou was caught off guard and was scalded by the hot tea and exclaimed. Her pink dress was soaked in large areas and she was in a miserable state.

The whole place fell silent for a moment.

Shen Qingrou felt hurt and embarrassed, her eyes immediately turned red, and she subconsciously wanted to frame Shen Qingyuan because Shen Qingyuan deliberately avoided her.Before the words could be spoken, the maid from the second lady's courtyard hurried over and whispered something into Shen Qingrou's ear with a flustered expression.Shen Qingrou took the snacks just sent from the kitchen to satisfy her hunger. At this moment, she felt cramps in her stomach, and the dignity she had just managed to maintain could no longer be maintained.

Aunt Liu's face suddenly changed. She never imagined that the carefully planned plan would all fall on her biological daughter in the end.

The old lady sat in the main seat and had a panoramic view of this scene. A hint of understanding flashed through her cloudy eyes, her face remained calm, and she only ordered her servants to help Shen Qingrou back to her room to rest.

Just as the scene was in chaos, the attendant outside the door suddenly announced loudly: "His Royal Highness the Prince Regent has arrived."

Xie Yuci, dressed in black robes, walked slowly into the garden. His figure was tall and straight, and the cold aura around him made the noise in the garden instantly subside.He was invited by Prime Minister Shen Jingshan on the way, but he didn't expect to encounter such a farce as soon as he entered. His eyes swept across the crowd casually, and finally fell on Shen Qingyuan, who was wearing a lake blue dress and an indifferent expression, and his eyes paused slightly.
